tools.name: architect.entries.list
tools.title: List Architect Entries
tools.description: List structured engineering memory entries by status, tag, or text query.

tools.name: cli.powershell.execute
tools.title: Execute PowerShell Script
tools.description: Runs a PowerShell script and returns ordered execution tracks, stdout, stderr, exit code, duration, and status.

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory. Defaults to the current JVM working directory.

timeoutMs.description: Optional execution timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 20000 and is capped by the tool.

executable.description: Optional PowerShell executable. Defaults to pwsh. Use powershell.exe for Windows PowerShell.

environment.description: Optional environment variables to add or override for the child process.

includeScriptInStructuredContent.description: Whether to echo the script body in structuredContent. Defaults to false.

tools.name: cobalt.info
tools.title: Cobalt Info
tools.description: Read version, supported services, and instance metadata from the configured Cobalt API.

tools.name: cobalt.process
tools.title: Process Media URL
tools.description: Submit a public media URL to Cobalt's POST / processing endpoint and return redirect, tunnel, picker, local-processing, or error details.

url.description: Public media URL to process through the configured Cobalt API instance.

audioFormat.description: Optional audio format: best, mp3, ogg, wav, or opus.

downloadMode.description: Optional download mode: auto, audio, or mute.

filenameStyle.description: Optional filename style: classic, pretty, basic, or nerdy.

disableMetadata.description: When true, request no embedded title, artist, or other metadata.

alwaysProxy.description: When true, request Cobalt to tunnel all files even when direct redirects are available.

localProcessing.description: Optional local processing preference: disabled, preferred, or forced.

youtubeVideoCodec.description: Optional YouTube video codec: h264, av1, or vp9.

youtubeVideoContainer.description: Optional YouTube video container: auto, mp4, webm, or mkv.

convertGif.description: When true, request Twitter/X GIF conversion to GIF format.

allowH265.description: When true, allow H265/HEVC videos from TikTok.

tiktokFullAudio.description: When true, request original full audio for TikTok videos.

youtubeBetterAudio.description: When true, prefer higher-quality YouTube audio when available.

youtubeHLS.description: When true, allow YouTube HLS formats if the configured Cobalt instance supports them.

tools.name: helloworld.greet
tools.description: Greet the Person.

name.description: The name of the person to greet

tools.name: instagram.fetch
tools.title: Instagram Fetch
tools.description: Fetches data from Instagram based on a given URL.

inputSchema.description: Fetches data from Instagram based on a given URL.

url.description: The URL of the Instagram post to fetch data from.

tools.name: omnivoice.clone
tools.title: Clone Voice With OmniVoice
tools.description: Generate speech from text using a constrained local reference audio file and optional reference transcript.

referenceAudioPath.description: Reference audio path under the configured OmniVoice reference root.

referenceText.description: Optional transcript of the reference audio. If absent, the wrapper may use ASR only when allowAutoTranscribe is true.

allowAutoTranscribe.description: Allow the wrapper to use ASR for missing referenceText.

outputPath.description: Relative output path under the configured OmniVoice output root. Defaults to a generated WAV file.

model.description: OmniVoice model id or local path. Defaults to meshingress.omnivoice.default-model.

duration.description: Optional fixed output duration in seconds.

device.description: Optional runtime device hint such as cuda:0, cpu, mps, or xpu.

dtype.description: Optional runtime dtype hint such as float16 or bfloat16.

tools.name: omnivoice.design
tools.title: Design OmniVoice Speech
tools.description: Generate speech from text and an OmniVoice voice-design instruction.

instruct.description: Voice design instruction, such as female, low pitch, british accent.

outputPath.description: Relative output path under the configured OmniVoice output root. Defaults to a generated WAV file.

model.description: OmniVoice model id or local path. Defaults to meshingress.omnivoice.default-model.

duration.description: Optional fixed output duration in seconds.

device.description: Optional runtime device hint such as cuda:0, cpu, mps, or xpu.

dtype.description: Optional runtime dtype hint such as float16 or bfloat16.

tools.name: omnivoice.generate
tools.title: Generate OmniVoice Speech
tools.description: Generate speech from text using the configured OmniVoice JSON CLI without a reference voice.

outputPath.description: Relative output path under the configured OmniVoice output root. Defaults to a generated WAV file.

model.description: OmniVoice model id or local path. Defaults to meshingress.omnivoice.default-model.

duration.description: Optional fixed output duration in seconds.

device.description: Optional runtime device hint such as cuda:0, cpu, mps, or xpu.

dtype.description: Optional runtime dtype hint such as float16 or bfloat16.

tools.name: omnivoice.models.pull
tools.title: Pull OmniVoice Models
tools.description: Ask the configured OmniVoice wrapper to prefetch models. Disabled by default.

model.description: OmniVoice model id or local path. Defaults to meshingress.omnivoice.default-model.

audioTokenizerModel.description: Audio tokenizer model id. Defaults to eustlb/higgs-audio-v2-tokenizer.

asrModel.description: ASR model id for optional auto transcription.

includeAsrModel.description: When true, include the optional ASR model in the pull request.

force.description: Ask the wrapper to refresh cached model assets.

tools.name: omnivoice.models.status
tools.title: OmniVoice Model Status
tools.description: Return configured OmniVoice model identifiers and local cache hints without pulling models.

model.description: Optional model id to report. Defaults to meshingress.omnivoice.default-model.

tools.name: omnivoice.runtime.health
tools.title: OmniVoice Runtime Health
tools.description: Return wrapper configuration and optionally probe the configured OmniVoice JSON CLI.

probeCommand.description: When true, call the configured wrapper runtime.health operation.

tools.name: omnivoice.voices.download
tools.title: Download OmniVoice Voice Asset
tools.description: Ask an explicitly enabled provider adapter to download or import a voice asset. Disabled by default.

outputVoiceId.description: Optional local voice id for the downloaded asset.

tools.name: omnivoice.voices.import
tools.title: Import Local OmniVoice Voice Asset
tools.description: Normalize a local reference audio file into the configured OmniVoice voice asset store.

voiceId.description: Optional stable voice id. Unsafe characters are normalized.

referenceAudioPath.description: Reference audio path under the configured OmniVoice reference root.

referenceText.description: Optional transcript of the reference audio.

tools.name: omnivoice.voices.providers
tools.title: List OmniVoice Voice Providers
tools.description: List configured voice provider adapters. Provider downloads are disabled by default.

includeDisabled.description: Reserved for future provider adapter listing.

tools.name: video.loop.find
tools.title: Find Loop Endpoint
tools.description: Given a selected start frame, find a matching later frame and optionally write a clipped loop file.

videoPath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative input video path.

startFrame.description: Frame index chosen as the loop beginning.

durationHint.description: Expected loop duration in frames. Used to center the search window.

searchRadius.description: Number of frames around durationHint to search.

outputPath.description: Optional output clip path. When omitted, only candidates are returned.

vendorScript.description: Optional path to video_loop_finder.py. Defaults to Meshingress/vendor/media/video-loop-finder/video_loop_finder.py.

tools.name: voicebox.generation_status
tools.title: Voicebox Generation Status
tools.description: Fetch Voicebox generation status for an id returned by voicebox.speak.

generationId.description: Voicebox generation id returned by voicebox.speak.

tools.name: voicebox.health
tools.title: Voicebox Health
tools.description: Read health, backend, GPU, and model status from the local Voicebox server.

tools.name: voicebox.list_profiles
tools.title: List Voicebox Profiles
tools.description: List available cloned and preset Voicebox profiles.

tools.name: voicebox.speak
tools.title: Speak With Voicebox
tools.description: Submit text to Voicebox /speak and return the generation id and status for polling.

profile.description: Optional Voicebox profile name or id. Falls back to the Voicebox per-client/default binding.

engine.description: Optional Voicebox engine: qwen, qwen_custom_voice, luxtts, chatterbox, chatterbox_turbo, tada, or kokoro.

personality.description: Whether Voicebox should rewrite the text through the selected profile personality before TTS.

language.description: Optional language code. Defaults to Voicebox's en behavior when omitted.

tools.name: voicebox.transcribe_file
tools.title: Transcribe Local Audio With Voicebox
tools.description: Upload a local audio file to Voicebox /transcribe and return the transcript.

audioPath.description: Absolute path to a local audio file readable by the Meshingress process.

model.description: Optional Whisper model: base, small, medium, large, or turbo.
